title: Exploring the Potential of Symbolic Regression in Precision Livestock Farming
abstract: arXiv:2610.39839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ability to predict farrowing time in pigs is crucial for optimal farm management and ensuring piglet survival. This study investigates the potential of explainable artificial intelligence for precision livestock farming, focusing on acceleration sensor data from sows around the time of farrowing. Accurately predicting farrowing allows farmers to balance both, piglet safety by avoiding piglet crushing events and the mother sow's welfare, by avoiding early crating. Traditional machine learning models often lack interpretability (``closed-box'' problem). Explainable artificial intelligence offers a solution by revealing the decision-making processes within the models. This work is split into two stages. First the detection of nest building behaviour and second the prediction of the remaining time to farrowing. The nest building detection was possible for 166 out of 180 sows and successful within 48 hours before farrowing for 149 sows.

translated_title: 探索符号回归在精准畜牧业中的潜力
translated_abstract: 摘要：预测母猪分娩时间的能力对于优化农场管理和确保仔猪存活至关重要。本研究探讨了可解释人工智能在精准畜牧业中的应用潜力，重点关注母猪分娩前后分娩时刻的加速度传感器数据。准确预测分娩可以使养殖户兼顾两方面：通过避免仔猪被压死事件来保障仔猪安全，以及通过避免过早关栏来维护母猪福利。传统机器学习模型通常缺乏可解释性（即“黑箱”问题）。可解释人工智能通过揭示模型内部的决策过程为这一问题提供了解决方案。这项工作分为两个阶段：第一阶段是筑巢行为的检测，第二阶段是预测距离分娩的剩余时间。在180头母猪中，有166头成功实现了筑巢行为检测，其中149头母猪在分娩前48小时内成功检测到筑巢行为。
tldr: 本研究利用可解释人工智能（符号回归）分析母猪加速度传感器数据，实现分娩前筑巢行为检测与分娩时间预测，从而兼顾仔猪安全与母猪福利。
